category_title: Middle school students with severe reading disabilities who disengage from traditional tasks
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete a traditional pen-to-paper writing task in his physical binder during a whole-class activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your physical binder and use your pen and paper to write a summary of the reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits in silence, looking at the blank paper and never asking for assistance.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should write first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows no desire to participate in the whole-class activity and leaves his pen on the desk.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to try to get some words down on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quietly puts his head on his desk and becomes 'invisible' due to his frustration surrounding academics.)
